svg.aria-label: From config file to running components: the file or URL is loaded, config.Parse reads strict JSON and looks each type up in the registry, producing a blueprint that config.Check examines; every error and warning is collected with its location. With errors, nothing runs. Without, apranik check builds everything through builder.Verify without dialing, binding or logging. apranik run builds the log sinks, statistics, datasets, the resolver, the outbounds, the DNS servers, the router and each inbound (which binds its listener), starts group probes and the accept loops, and starts the APIs last. A reload, from SIGHUP or the API, checks the config source again, closes the running core and starts the new one, or starts the previous configuration again if the new one does not start.
